title: Preserve structured message boundaries for GitHub provider prompt formatting
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 10.3. Current GitHub prompt formatting flattens messages. Preserve role/message boundaries using structured API primitives when available, with compatibility fallback and evaluation checks on multi-turn quality.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented the compatibility fallback in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` after verifying the GitHub.Copilot.SDK `MessageOptions` surface only exposes a single `Prompt` field, not a structured messages collection. The GitHub provider now serializes the full conversation as a structured JSON envelope with ordered `role`/`content` items inside `<conversation-json>` markers instead of flattening messages into lossy `ROLE:` text blocks. Added regression coverage in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs` to prove multi-turn roles, order, and multiline content survive formatting. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~GitHubCopilotChatProvider_FormatsPromptAsStructuredConversationEnvelope|Name~ChatProviders_ReportCapabilityMetadata|Name~Chat"` (110/110 passed).
